instance_description:
Setting: 2026 personal health maintenance for a Chicago-based intercity rail conductor whose work alternates station reports, overnight layovers, passenger-service shifts, and days at home.
Scope: Covers nonurgent appointment preparation, saved professional guidance, sleep routines around rail trips, foot and back conditioning, travel meals, hydration, hearing comfort, and portable supply checks.
Resources: Empty SQLite tables can later store Marek-related context, established guidance, and routine logs; blank TXT files can hold guidance, trip checklists, appointment notes, and supply summaries.
Exclusions: No diagnosis, treatment choice, medication or dosage changes, emergency triage, workplace safety rulings, insurance disputes, or contacting providers or railroad staff without explicit scenario permission.
personal_description:
Identity: Marek Julian Osei is a 45-year-old intercity passenger rail conductor living in Chicago, Illinois, throughout 2026.
Responsibilities: Marek manages personal appointments, layover sleep preparation, stretching and conditioning, meal planning between stations, hydration habits, hearing-comfort supplies, footwear care, and routine replenishment of travel health items.
Authority: Marek may organize records, set reminders, compare personal and work schedules, follow saved clinician, physical therapist, dietitian, or trainer guidance, and choose ordinary logistics within established plans.
Restrictions: Marek does not ask the agent to diagnose symptoms, select treatments, alter prescriptions, judge urgent concerns, or message clinicians, dispatchers, coworkers, or hotels unless a Scenario explicitly allows it.
